title: Keep the Space coach profile private to the owner and editors, and stop spending Opus on question-only coaching

source.ref: Review of the Codex AI coaching overhaul, 2026-10-26

detail: The private Space coach profile could be written, and sent to the model vendor through the bio and tagline coaching actions, by platform staff and network admins, because those actions gated on canEditProfile (which staff preview and network reach satisfy). The settings page also loaded it for staff preview. All three now require authorizeDiscoveryEditor (the owner or an active direct editor, fresh read, no staff or network reach), and the page does not load the profile for anyone else. Separately, journey-edit, journey-composition and practice-edit asked Opus for at most four short questions; they now use Sonnet. approveAction in the marketing agent also ignored the result of executeAction, so a refused send showed as approved; it now throws. Left for follow-up: question validators do not reject quoted draft text (writing-questions, writing-coaching, space-copilot, vera-conversation checks), the conversation coach sends the member transcript with author names, the importer review board still carries dead mood and lock controls, and legacy winback proposals block re-proposal.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the coach profile actions use the owner-or-editor check and the three coaching callers no longer use Opus.
